purpose: No-spend attribution after the bounded tile_10 density-relaxed repair passed artifact gates but failed V18 same-camera non-regression.

rollback_isolation.interpretation: Replacing tile_10 with V18/context-density while leaving the accepted tile_11 cache in place restores V18 non-regression.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The tile_10 issue is only insufficient retained density.
ruled_out.reason: The density-relaxed candidate retained 206,827 more gaussians than V18 but still regressed near_detail, boundary, and horizon same-camera metrics.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The accepted tile_11 cache is the primary blocker.
ruled_out.reason: Rollback isolation kept the accepted tile_11 cache and promoted against V18 non-regression.

remaining_likely_confounds.hypothesis: Merge-mode mismatch changed the full-scene distribution.
remaining_likely_confounds.evidence: V18/rollback isolation used support_weighted_overlap; density-relaxed full-scene merge used strict_core.
remaining_likely_confounds.next_test: Rebuild the same density-relaxed tile_10 full-scene artifact with support_weighted_overlap before changing training again.

remaining_likely_confounds.hypothesis: The repaired tile_10 changes sky/horizon/background ownership.
remaining_likely_confounds.evidence: The rejected candidate selected tile_10 background and failed horizon sky score plus DJI_0073.JPG single-camera PSNR.
remaining_likely_confounds.next_test: If support_weighted_overlap still fails, isolate background/skybox selection with V18/rollback background before retraining.

remaining_likely_confounds.hypothesis: Tile_10 needs context/camera-selection repair, not just density relaxation.
remaining_likely_confounds.evidence: The repaired leaf passed preflight with 1,733,527 splats and 188 images but still degraded same-camera V18 review after merge.
remaining_likely_confounds.next_test: Only after no-training isolation fails, run a bounded tile_10 proof with explicit horizon/boundary context and frozen-camera target DJI_0073.JPG.

ranked_next_steps.step: No-training support_weighted_overlap remarge of the rejected density-relaxed tile_10 candidate.
ranked_next_steps.cost_basis: About $0.30 g4dn merge plus about $0.33 same-camera review if submitted.
ranked_next_steps.why_first: It isolates the strict_core versus support_weighted_overlap confound without spending on new training.

ranked_next_steps.step: No-training background/skybox isolation if support_weighted_overlap still fails.
ranked_next_steps.why_second: The current block is horizon-heavy, and background ownership changed with the repaired tile.

ranked_next_steps.step: Bounded tile_10 context/camera-selection repair only after no-training isolation fails.
ranked_next_steps.why_third: Another paid leaf train should target the identified same-camera horizon/boundary failure rather than retrying density-only changes.

stop_rule: Do not launch another paid tile trial or any full 14-tile run until the support_weighted_overlap no-training isolation is reviewed or explicitly skipped.
